title: Meta Pixel cross-window handling lost message and token authority
product: Meta Pixel and Instagram account integrations
summary: The researcher reports a USD 32,500 bounty for this single disclosed finding or chain.
root_cause: A trusted-origin check did not establish the authority of cross-window messages. Sensitive page context could enter requests under another identity, alongside inconsistent authorization-grant binding.
impact: The researcher reports exposure of Instagram authorization material and consequent account takeover under the documented interaction conditions. Broad script deployment does not establish identical impact on every embedding site.
defensive_takeaways: Bind cross-window messages to their expected sender and transaction context.
Keep authorization material out of general analytics data and verify grant-to-client binding.

reward.notes: One researcher-reported bug bounty, not an event total. The article uses $; prior official Meta program reporting supplies USD context. Actual cash settlement is not established.
